summary: A riding horse (about 15 hands, 1.55 m at the withers) on the engine's quadruped_20 rig, so the built-in quad… options coat, mane, legs, saddle_cloth, tack, blaze; sockets seat_driver, head_top, back, collar.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.horse or place "prefab": "horse" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
